title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive

Manchester City Centre

£25k basic uncapped OTE

The Role

As our client continues to grow, we're looking to bring a hungry, commercially minded Business Development Executive into the team.

This is a front line role in a fast moving finance brokerage, perfect for someone who enjoys conversations with business owners, understands sales fundamentals and wants a clear path to progression.

What you'll be doing:
- Speaking with UK SMEs about funding requirements, specifically focussing on invoice finance and cashflow lending.
- Managing inbound lead flow (we will give you lots of leads).
- Building your own network & outbound lead origination strategy.
- Building long-term relationships with introducers, clients and lenders.

What we're looking for:
- Confident communicator (phone-first mindset).
- Commercial curiosity. finance experience is a bonus, not essential.
- Resilient, driven, and organised.
- Someone who wants to build a career, not just do a job.

What's in it for you:
- Competitive base + industry leading lifetime commission scheme.
- Working closely with the directors on a daily basis.
- Uncapped earning potential.
- Small, ambitious company with real momentum (100% year on year growth since incorporation).
- Central Manchester office location and get to work with three top fellas!

title: Sales Advisor
description:
Sales Advisor

Didsbury, Manchester

Starting Salary £34,796 rising to Spot Salary £36,627 (At 2 years, subject to satisfactory performance)

Permanent, Full Time

Reporting to the Sales Manager, the Sales Advisor will be working for Plumlife, the award winning Sales and Marketing department. You will effectively market and sell new build, shared ownership and market sale homes for the company, Cube and other external partners and clients.

What you'll be doing
- Responsible for sales of new build shared ownership and market sale homes, in line with the required sales targets.
- Respond in a timely manner to all inquiries and sales leads to ensure high conversion rates.
- Assess the eligibility of potential buyers', maintaining accurate documentation throughout the sales process for audit purposes.
- Conduct viewing appointments at sales developments, explaining the shared ownership scheme to customers and securing reservations.
- Maintain accurate information in databases and systems for performance tracking and reporting.
- Liaise with solicitors, IFA's, valuers, and our development team to ensure quick progression of sales and manage legal documents.
- Attend site meetings and provide input on design and specification of new homes.
- Assist with coordinating marketing literature and promotional activities.
- Manage sales launches, open days, and ensure accurate website entries for marketing purposes.
- Provide an exceptional level of customer service and follow all company policies and procedures.
- Occasional out-of-hours and regular weekend working required.

What you'll need
- Competent use of Microsoft office systems including word and excel.
- Driving licence and use of a vehicle for business purposes (with business use insurance cover).
- Experience within a property /development sales background.
- Knowledge of property development process.
- An understanding of shared ownership.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Experience in a fast-paced customer focussed environment and able to deliver an exceptional standard of customer service.
- Ability to provide concise and accurate reports.
- Ability to complete tasks in an accurate and timely manner when working under pressure.
- Attention to detail.
- Effective liaison with colleagues/other stakeholders to give information/find information/resolve problems.
- Organisation and ability to manage workload.
- The ability to develop and project a positive image of the company through personal, written and oral skills.

What we need from you
- You will be required to attend a number of face to face training sessions as well as virtual sessions and e-learning this part of your role is vital and of equal importance as the day to day aspects.
- A commitment to understand the challenges and opportunities that exist in the communities in which we work. We particularly value lived experience in social housing
- A passion to advocate on behalf of people and communities
- A commitment to work in partnership with others for the benefit of the company
- A commitment to continuous learning and improvement
- Ability to work flexibly and when needed

What we give you in return for your hard work and commitment
- Pension DC Scheme (up to 10% contribution from both colleague and company)
- WPA Healthcare auto enrolled at no contribution level with £1250 of savings available- option to increase & add on family members
- The Market Place High street, restaurant & supermarket discounts, gym memberships, cycle to work, smart tech loans and much more
- Annual Leave Start at 26 days annual leave, increasing up to 30 days within 5 years+ Bank Holidays
- Reward & Recognition You Count Rewards are individual reward's for going 'above & beyond'
- Help with transport We offer season ticket loans, an affordable way to purchase season tickets for public transport at discounted rates.
- Wage Stream You can access savings opportunities and early access to wages

We believe the wellbeing of our colleagues is vital to enable them to deliver to great services, all your benefits can be used inside and outside of work.

We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and adults and expects all our colleagues to share this commitment. All successful applicant(s) will be subject to an enhanced criminal records background check (Child and Adult Workforce, Child Barred List).Further detail on our commitment to safeguarding children/young people & vulnerable adults can be found in the Safeguarding Policy & Recruitment Policy on our website.

title: Sales Executive - Financial Services
description:
Sales Executive - Financial ServicesCeMAP Qualification Fully Funded! If you don't already hold your CeMAP qualification, the company will fully fund your training and get you started straight away. Once qualified, you'll move up to the top salary of £35,154, giving you the opportunity to significantly increase your earning potential.Location: Manchester City Centre - Hybrid after probationSalary: £27,415 without CeMAP, £35,154 with CeMAP qualification.OTE: £41,000 typical / up to £50,000 Hours: Full-time, 35 hours per week (Standard office hours, Mon - Fri)Hybrid: Office based during probation period, then minimum 3 days per week in the office following successful completion of probation.We're currently recruiting for an exciting opportunity with a growing financial services business based in Manchester City Centre. This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced advised sales professional looking to develop their career within the financial services and lending sector. You'll be joining a customer-focused team where you'll manage warm leads, understand customers' individual circumstances and provide tailored solutions, while working within a highly regulated environment.The Role As a Sales Executive, you will:
- Manage and convert leads across multiple channels.
- Speak with customers to understand their individual needs and circumstances.
- Provide tailored recommendations and deliver a high level of customer service.
- Work towards and consistently achieve agreed sales, service and performance targets.
- Ensure all customer interactions comply with FCA regulations and responsible lending requirements.
- Follow company policies, procedures and regulatory guidelines.
- Maintain high standards of professionalism and ethical conduct.
- Take ownership of your performance and strive to exceed agreed targets.

About You We're looking for candidates with previous experience in a financial services sales environment. You'll need:
- At least 12 months' experience in an advised finance services sales role.
- Experience of working in a contact centre environment
- A proven track record of achieving sales and performance targets.
- Strong communication and customer service skills.
- Excellent listening and questioning skills, with the ability to understand customer needs.
- Good decision-making and problem-solving abilities.
- The ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
- A commitment to working within regulatory and compliance requirements.
- The ability to work from the Manchester City Centre office at least 3 days per week (following probationary period).

CeMAP Qualification CeMAP qualification is desirable, although candidates who are part-qualified or do not currently hold CeMAP will also be considered. If you don't currently hold the qualification, you'll need to demonstrate a genuine commitment to achieving it, with training and support provided.What's on Offer?
- £27,415 - £35,154 basic salary, dependent on CeMAP qualification.
- £41,000 typical OTE, with potential to earn up to £50,000.
- Up to 25 days' annual leave + bank holidays.
- Your birthday off every year.
- Healthcare cash plan.
- Contributory pension scheme with employer matching up to 5%.
- Long service awards.
- Cycle to work scheme.
- Life assurance.
- Support and training to develop your career within financial services.
- Hybrid working available following successful completion of probation.

The Environment This is an opportunity to join a business with a strong focus on customer outcomes, responsible lending and financial inclusion. You'll be working within an FCA-regulated environment, so you'll be expected to meet the relevant FCA Conduct Rules and maintain the required standards of fitness and propriety.Please note: Successful applicants will be required to complete a credit check and DBS check as part of the recruitment process.If you're an experienced advised sales professional looking for your next opportunity, particularly if you're looking to progress within financial services and develop your CeMAP qualification, we'd love to hear from you.Disclaimer CCA Recruitment Group is an employment agency with a legitimate interest in providing work finding services. Please be advised that by submitting your CV to CCA Recruitment Group, directly or via any of our job advertisement platforms, and all telephone calls may be recorded for training and auditing purposes, your personal data will be held on our secure internal CRM system indefinitely. The personal data contained therein will not be shared with any third parties without your express consent. As an individual, you have the right to withdraw consent at any time. Following a period of 10 years inactivity your CV will be deleted permanently from our database.

title: Temporary Outbound Sales Executive
description:
Temporary Outbound Sales Executive

Salford - M50 (Free Parking Onsite)

Monday - Friday (Fulltime in the office)

9am-5pm (1hr lunch)

Up to 14.36 per hour (Depending on Experience)

ASAP - 4 Weeks (Possibility to be extended or taken on permanently for the right person)

Must have previous Outbound Sales Experience

Our client, a dynamic organisation within the Manufacturing of Medical Equipment, is seeking a Temporary Outbound Sales Executive to join their team during a busy period of growth. This is an exceptional opportunity to engage with a variety of healthcare organisations across the UK, promoting vital equipment and services that enhance patient care.

Key Responsibilities:
- Proactively contact existing customers to explore opportunities for additional products and services.
- Focus on upselling calibration and servicing solutions to clients who have previously purchased equipment.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, identifying ways to add value and boost account revenue.
- Follow up on warm leads generated from the existing customer base, making a high volume of outbound calls.
- Understand customer requirements and provide tailored recommendations based on their specific products and servicing needs.
- Accurately manage and update customer information within the CRM system.
- Collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure a seamless customer experience.

About the Role:
- This is a predominantly outbound sales position with access to a robust pipeline of warm leads.
- Perfect for individuals who thrive in relationship-led sales rather than cold calling.
- An ideal opportunity for ambitious candidates looking to develop their sales career within a growing organisation.

Skills & Experience:
- Previous experience in sales, telesales, account management or customer service roles is essential.
- Confident communicator with exceptional telephone and relationship-building skills.
- Commercially minded with a natural flair for identifying upselling opportunities.
- Self-motivated, proactive and target-driven to achieve success.
- Strong organisational skills with meticulous attention to detail.
- A positive attitude and a genuine desire to grow and advance within the organisation.

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
Pickfords is an iconic British brand, moving excellence is our passion and we have been relocating families and businesses locally and across the world for over 350 years.

We are seeking a dedicated and enthusiastic individual to join our Move Manager Team, with a passion for customer service and a desire to exceed our clients expectations.

Job Purpose

As a Move Manager, you will be the customer's main point of contact throughout their move, delivering excellent customer service and ensuring every move is managed smoothly from enquiry to completion.

Working closely with colleagues across the business, you will coordinate each move, maintain accurate records, identify sales opportunities and provide a seamless, stress-free experience for every customer.

Key Responsibilities
- Be the customer's dedicated point of contact throughout their moving journey.
- Understand customer needs and deliver an outstanding customer experience.
- Identify opportunities to promote and upsell relevant products and services.
- Process customer documentation accurately and in line with company procedures and legal requirements.
- Manage customer enquiries, quotes, bookings and administration efficiently within agreed timescales.
- Deliver excellent customer service while achieving agreed KPIs and performance targets.
- Resolve customer queries and issues promptly and professionally.
- Build strong working relationships with colleagues and other departments to ensure moves run smoothly.
- Participate in team meetings, briefings and training, sharing ideas and best practice.
- Carry out any other duties appropriate to the role.

Key Performance Areas
- Manage incoming calls and customer enquiries professionally and promptly.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer records within the CRM system.
- Maximise enquiry to quote and booking through effective sales and customer service.
- Follow the three-call process to maximise sales opportunities and deliver excellent customer service.
- Process customer payments accurately in line with company procedures.
- Resolve customer queries and complaints efficiently.
- Deliver exceptional customer service that encourages positive feedback, online reviews and recommendations.
- Follow company policies, procedures and compliance standards to ensure a consistent, high-quality customer experience.

Skills, Knowledge & Experience
- Excellent communication and listening skills, with the ability to build rapport with customers and colleagues.
- Strong customer focus with a passion for delivering outstanding service.
- Positive, enthusiastic and self-motivated with a proactive, can-do attitude.
- Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise workloads.
- Flexible and adaptable, responding positively to changing priorities.
- Calm and professional when working under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
- Results-driven with a commitment to delivering work to a high standard.
- A team player who enjoys collaborating and sharing best practice.
- Motivated to achieve personal and team objectives.
- Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Office applications such as Word, Excel and Outlook.

If you are a motivated individual with a passion for logistics and relocation services, we would love to hear from you. 'Apply' now to join our dynamic team.

Candidates will only be contacted if they are invited for an interview. You must be eligible to work in the UK.

We are committed to equal opportunities for all, irrespective of race, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sexuality, disability, marital status or age.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Work Location: In person

title: Temporary Outbound Customer Advisor - Warm Enquiries
description:
OUTBOUND CUSTOMER SUCCESS ADVISOR

Salford M50- Parking onsite

Monday- Friday (Fulltime in the office)

9am-5pm

13.33 per hour ( 26k)

ASAP - Ongoing (Possibility to be extended or taken on permanently for the right person)

Are you ready to make a difference in the retail appliance industry? Our client is on the lookout for a dynamic and enthusiastic Outbound Customer Success Advisor to join their growing team at their head office in Salford! If you thrive in a high-volume call environment and enjoy helping customers succeed, we want to hear from you!

What You'll Do:
As a pivotal member of the team, your mission will be to connect with customers and enhance their experience with our client's Reward scheme. Here's what you can expect to do:
- Engage Customers: Reach out to customers who have onboarded but haven't yet claimed their rewards, guiding them through the claims process with care and clarity.
- Support Onboarding: Assist customers who faced challenges during onboarding, diagnosing issues and ensuring they complete the process smoothly.
- Customer Satisfaction Checks: Follow up with customers who have recently had products installed to gauge their satisfaction with the product and service.
- Issue Logging: Identify and log any concerns raised, escalating issues as needed to ensure prompt resolutions.
- Quote Progression: Contact customers who have requested quotes but haven't provided necessary information to move forward.
- Follow-Up: Reconnect with customers who haven't responded to previous requests for additional information.
- Remove Blockers: Work diligently to eliminate any obstacles in the quoting process, striving to convert more inquiries into booked and paid installations.
- Record Keeping: Maintain accurate records of all calls, outcomes and customer interactions in the CRM system.
- Feedback Loop: Collaborate closely with the Customer Service Manager to report common issues or trends.
- Brand Representation: Always represent the company professionally, reflecting brand values and building customer trust.

What We're Looking For:
To succeed in this role, you should possess the following qualities:
- Rapport Builder: An ability to connect quickly with customers and maintain a friendly telephone manner.
- Problem Solver: A keen mindset for identifying key issues and offering effective resolutions.
- Efficient Worker: An organised and conscientious approach to managing multiple call types throughout your day.
- Tech-Savvy: Basic IT literacy to effectively utilise CRM systems and tools.

Performance Measures:
Your success will be measured by:
- The number of successfully completed calls leading to customer onboarding.
- The number of quotes progressed to booked and paid.
- Call volume and quality against set targets.
- The number of 4- and 5-star customer reviews generated as a result of your outbound efforts.

Apply Now!
